plan: My value of $40 is unusually high given the range is $0 to $20. Bidding exactly $20 dominates lower bids, as I can win and pay the second-highest bid, maximizing profit. Higher bids offer no advantage since they don't increase my profit and risk overpaying. Thus, I will bid $20, ensuring I win if others bid within the expected range.

Given my private value of $42, I should aim to win the auction while ensuring my profit margin is positive. A bid of $15 is a strategic choice, as it is high enough to outbid typical average bids but low enough to secure profit if I win.

Since my private value is $28, I should bid slightly below this to ensure a potential profit if I win. Bidding exactly $28 would mean no profit if I win. To avoid dominated bids, I'll bid slightly above the midpoint of likely bids from others, assuming they value the prize lower.
